messages:
amanda: heads up — deploybot blocked the 09:00 canary for inference-service. says config parity failed between staging and prod. :eyes:

deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT: FAILED
Reason: CONFIG_PARITY_MISMATCH
Details: missing/ divergent keys -> INFER_SIGNATURE, MODEL_PIN
(see diff snippet below)

jess: ugh — staging is already on infer_signature=v2 and model pin open-llm/roberta-infer:v2 for the canary. prod still on v1. that explains the 422s in smoke tests.

ryan: can you paste the diff? I want to confirm it's not just a comment typo.

amanda: here — quick excerpt from deploy-check output:

```
--- staging.yaml
INFER_SIGNATURE: v2
MODEL_PIN: open-llm/roberta-infer:v2
PROMPT_SCHEMA: {text,context,top_k}
--- production.yaml
INFER_SIGNATURE: v1
MODEL_PIN: open-llm/roberta-infer:v1
PROMPT_SCHEMA: {text}
```

liz: confirmed — v2 changed the prompt contract (added context/top_k). If prod goes live expecting v1 schema, upstream product calls will 422. We should hold.

ryan: agree. roll the canary back to staging config while we decide? or pin the staged model to v1 for the release window?

jess: I prefer pinning staging to v1 for the canary rollout window (less blast radius). Can we patch the staging helm values to MODEL_PIN=v1 and re-run the canary check?

deploy-bot: ACTION_REQUIRED: Manual approval to patch staging MODEL_PIN -> open-llm/roberta-infer:v1

infra-oncall: I can apply the staging override and kick the preflight. Expect ~4m for pods to reconcile.

amanda: +1 to the staging pin. also updating release notes: mention that infer_signature v2 will be rolled out in a follow-up with a migration plan for prompt schema.

liz: decision: HOLD release. Patch staging MODEL_PIN -> v1, re-run preflight. After green, perform canary again and if green, proceed with release. If any downstream contract error appears, rollback to previous image across canary nodes.

ryan: I'll update the release checklist and add a migration task in the notes. tagging product to coordinate prompt clients. @jess please add a short runbook entry under releases/inference-schema.md

jess: on it. adding a note about validating prompt_schema fields in smoke tests and adding an explicit contract check to preflight.

amanda: thanks — infra-oncall, proceed when ready. I'll close the release window in the console for now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: NOTE: release window paused by amanda — reason: CONFIG_PARITY_MISMATCH (INFER_SIGNATURE).

infra-oncall: applied staging override, re-running deploy-check now. will report back in thread.

(END)
